messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] windows version
messages.body_plain:
Hi

Yes, unfortunately, due to a very minor issue, the packgae has been
removed form CRAN by the CRAN maintainers, and I have failed to sumbit a
new version. I hope to submit very soon, but in the meanwhile, you can
still install it, using:

library(devtools)
install_github("tsDyn", ref="Dev94", username="MatthieuStigler",
subdir="tsDyn")

note if on windows you might need ot install Rtools, as installing tsdyn
requires compilation.

Best

Matthieu

messages.subject: tsDyn: back on CRAN, with version 0.9-33
messages.subject_clean: tsDyn: back on CRAN, with version 0.9-33
messages.body_plain:
Hi

tsDyn is finally back on CRAN, with a new version 0.9-33, which is
mainly a maintenance version, correcting the minor issues that led it to
be temporarily out of CRAN. In addition to this, it corrects a bug in
VARrep() found by Paul Schreck (thanks!), as well as a bug in resvar().
See the Changelog for more details.

Best

Matthieu
